SELECT a.task_id AS taskId, a.alarm_body AS alarmBody, a.warning_order_id AS warningOrderId, a.warning_type_id AS warningTypeId, a.warning_source AS warningSource, IF(a.alarm_time IS NULL, '', DATE_FORMAT(a.alarm_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s')) AS alarmTime, a.province_code AS provinceId, a.city_code AS cityId, a.county_code AS countyId, a.province_name AS provinceName, a.city_name AS cityName, a.county_name AS countyName, a.address, a.longitude, a.latitude, a.emergency_level AS emergencyLevel, a.importance_level AS importanceLevel, a.tenant_id AS tenantId, a.tenant_name AS tenantName, a.device_code AS deviceCode, a.channel_code AS channelCode, a.channel_name AS channelName, a.device_name AS deviceName, a.device_address AS deviceAddress, a.alarm_code AS alarmCode, a.description, a.remark, IFNULL(a.video_url, '') AS videoUrl, IFNULL(a.file_img_url_src, '') AS fileImgUrlSrc, IFNULL(a.file_img_url_icon, '') AS fileImgUrlIcon, IFNULL(a.grid_id, '') AS gridId, IFNULL(a.grid_name, '') AS gridName, a.extra_field AS extraField, a.industry_code AS tradeId, a.app_ver_code AS appVerCode, a.hori_azimuth_angle AS horiAzimuthAngle, a.feature_pan AS featurePan, a.feature_tilt AS featureTilt, IFNULL(a.confidence_level, '') AS confidenceLevel, IFNULL(a.front_alarm_pic_url, '') AS frontAlarmPicUrl, IFNULL(a.front_alarm_vedio_url, '') AS frontAlarmVedioUrl, IFNULL(a.comp_confidence_level, '') AS compConfidenceLevel, a.confidence_level_min AS confidenceLevelMin, a.confidence_level_max AS confidenceLevelMax, a.enlarge_flag AS enlargeFlag, a.preset_id AS presetId, a.camera_alarm_type AS cameraAlarmType, a.is_second_judge AS isSecondJudge, a.second_judge_result AS secondJudgeResult, a.is_second_identify AS isSecondIdentify, a.second_identify_result AS secondIdentifyResult, a.linkage_algorithm AS linkageAlgorithm, a.notice_resource AS noticeResource, a.msg_type AS msgType, IFNULL(a.ptz_p, '') AS pan, IFNULL(a.ptz_t, '') AS tilt, IFNULL(a.ptz_z, '') AS zoom, a.device_pitch AS devicePitch, a.device_horizontal AS deviceHorizontal, a.algorithm_code AS algorithmCode, a.pitch_angle AS pitchAngle, a.hori_field_angle AS horiFieldAngle, a.vertical_field_angle AS verticalFieldAngle, a.alarm_param AS alarmParam, a.alarm_param_value AS alarmParamValue FROM ${tableName} a WHERE a.warning_order_id IN
#{orderId}
